# visualization.design_map.design_map { #fmrimod.visualization.design_map.design_map }

```python
design_map(
    model,
    block_separators=True,
    rotate_x_text=True,
    fill_midpoint=None,
    fill_limits=None,
    figsize=None,
    cmap=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Visualize design matrix as a heatmap.

Creates a heatmap visualization of the design matrix showing the
intensity of each regressor at each time point.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                        | Description                                                                     | Default    |
|------------------|-----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| model            | EventModel or BaselineModel | Event model or baseline model containing the design matrix to visualize         | _required_ |
| block_separators | bool                        | Whether to draw separators between blocks/runs if available                     | `True`     |
| rotate_x_text    | bool                        | Whether to rotate x-axis labels for better readability                          | `True`     |
| fill_midpoint    | float                       | Midpoint for diverging color scale. If None, uses continuous scale              | `None`     |
| fill_limits      | tuple of float              | (min, max) limits for color scale. If None, uses data range                     | `None`     |
| figsize          | tuple of float              | Figure size as (width, height). If None, automatically determined               | `None`     |
| cmap             | str                         | Colormap name. If None, uses 'RdBu_r' for diverging or 'viridis' for continuous | `None`     |
| **kwargs         | object                      | Additional arguments passed to matplotlib's imshow                              | `{}`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description       |
|--------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| fig    | matplotlib.figure.Figure | The figure object |
| ax     | matplotlib.axes.Axes     | The axes object   |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Basic usage
>>> fig, ax = design_map(model)
>>>
>>> # With custom colormap and size
>>> fig, ax = design_map(model, figsize=(12, 8), cmap='coolwarm')
>>>
>>> # Focus on specific value range
>>> fig, ax = design_map(model, fill_limits=(-2, 2))
```
